descriptions.text: Enchanted Shade Gnoll Riot Forces Telescoping Crowd Control Baton. This enchanted truncheon is designed to crack skulls and to teach those ungrateful bastards to show some got-damned respect. This item's length is adjustable, from 25 centimeters to 3 meters. Automatically casts Level-five Cone of Knockback if swung at a group of 10 or more like mobs. This triggers only once every five minutes.

beats.headline: Not a baseball bat
beats.text: The other thing out of Katia's fan box looks like a baseball bat, and it is actually a police baton. At first glance there is nothing special about it, but as Katia rolls it over in her hands, eyes wide and lips tight, Carl sees the slight glow of enchantment. Its length adjusts from twenty-five centimetres to three metres, and swung at a group of ten or more like mobs it automatically casts a level-five Cone of Knockback, once every five minutes. Those are both pretty awesome, Carl says. Especially the shield.

beats.headline: Swung one way
beats.text: Crowd Blast has carried Katia into the hallway full of Krakaren monsters and ghouls, all the way to the first intersection, a T with short stairwells going down on either side. Dazed but still on her feet, she pulls her crowd-control baton and swings it in one direction while the crossbow flips upside-down and fires in the other. Carl comes running up behind her with a second boom jug in his hand.
